page.overview:
What is 8th Branch?

The Marine 8th Branch is a non-canon Marine unit active in East Blue, commanded by Nelson Royal.

The division consists of Nelson's flagship and a fleet of at least ten smaller battleships. They also hired Eric the Whirlwind to bolster their military forces, but was betrayed by the mercenary when he found them no use to his personal agenda any longer.

The unit possesses a small fleet of at least 10 ships along with the special flag ship. The main technique which this branch uses to capture pirates is the , which consists of surrounding an enemy with a fleet of battleships and then blocking all escape routes by connecting each battleship with several large chains.
